The '''Gavos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gavos system was established in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square Q-10.<ref name="EAOC" />
